coder_notes: Brief summary describes the record as a 'draft, ClinicalTrials.gov-style example record'; adjudicator may want to check whether this is a genuine registration. Only intervention is a CAR-NK cell therapy (excluded type); cyclophosphamide and fludarabine are lymphodepleting conditioning (supportive per R6), so no pharmacological candidate. Entry also requires expression of at least two of IL13Ra2, EGFR/EGFRvIII, B7-H3 ('Tumor demonstrates expression of at least two of the following antigens above protocol-defined thresholds'); each antigen coded as enrichment for the cohorts it defines. None candidate-matched because the CAR-NK product is not a candidate. control_arm_from_other_arms 'no': three biomarker-defined experimental cohorts, none a control. Intracranial catheter is a device, not listed.
